label: Lantas 1.4.0 development build
changes: Screen: share your screen in a card that answers questions about what is on it.
Screen: Lantas can point at a control. It draws a temporary ring above your apps, click-through and always on top.
Browser: when you click, type or scroll while the agent is driving, it stops and reads what you did before continuing.
Browser: a pending sign-in detail replaces the page suggestions with a form to fill in.
Browser: the mini view in chat zooms out to show the whole page instead of cropping it.
Code: the empty-workspace buttons wrap instead of running past the card.
Storage: the local backup no longer fills up and fails when sessions carry screenshots.
